informal_statement:
One has
\[
0<\varepsilon<r<h
\]
and
\[
A_3(\varepsilon)>A_4(h).
\]
The level set \(Z_{\lambda,h,\varepsilon}\) is nonempty and compact, with greatest element \(r\) and
\[
A_3(r)=A_4(h).
\]
For \(r<t\leq h\),
\[
A_3(t)<A_4(h).
\]
The function \(Q_{\lambda,h}\) is continuous on \([r,h]\), has derivative
\[
A_4(h)-A_3(t)>0
\]
on \((r,h)\), and satisfies
\[
Q_{\lambda,h}(r)<Q_{\lambda,h}(h).
\]
reason: Source `CMVElementary.lean:125-140`: The same witnesses satisfy compactness, greatestness, the right-hand strict barrier and all support-function claims; none is replaced by uniqueness.
